subject: reactiveValues and observeEvent working differently on shinyapps.io vs. shinyserver

messages.author: e9ea40ad71e07dc0
messages.subject: reactiveValues and observeEvent working differently on shinyapps.io vs. shinyserver
parts:
I am trying to set the initial value of a Data Table. See the simplified code example below. It works where ever I host it.

But:
1. The more complicated version only works locally on my machine or on shinyapps, it does not run on my AWS site running shinyserver.
2. I have isolated the portion of the code that does not work in the full version. It is in trying to set the initial values based on reactive function events and to reactive function values.

I can comment out the red text equivalent version in the full version to get it to work on shinyserver. Is there an alternate way to code this so the initial values are preset. I basically couldn't figure out the syntax to set up reactiveValues with a more complex coding of initial values.


In the simplifed version, I thought if I could get something like this to work it would solve my issues with the full/complex version running on shiny server.:

EditInventory<-reactiveValues(data<-({
      a<-"initial"
      b<-"values"
      data<-paste(a,b)
    })
    )

Simplified Version works everywhere, full version where Inventory is a call to RMySQL does not work on shinyserver.
I can comment out the red text equivalents in the full version and it works

shinyApp(
  ui = fluidPage(
    
    
    textOutput("Initial"),br(),
    textOutput("Edit"),br(),
    actionButton("update",label="UPDATE")
  ),
  
  server = function(input, output) {
    
    output$Initial <- renderText(paste("Inventory Table contains: ",Inventory(),sep=''))
    
    output$Edit <- renderText(paste("Edit Inventory Table contains: ",EditInventory$data,sep=''))
    
    Inventory<-reactive({
      Inventory<-"Initial Values"
      return(Inventory)
    })
    
    EditInventory<-reactiveValues(data=NULL)
    
    observeEvent(Inventory(),{
      EditInventory$data <- Inventory()})
    
    observeEvent(input$update,{
      EditInventory$data <- "Updated Values"})
    
    

  }
)


Thanks in advance!!!
MIke
